The AI module was unavailable and the zone score fallback produced nothing, indicating the fallback thresholds are too restrictive or the fallback logic has a bug preventing any output.

The regime should have helped, but the system completely failed to capitalize because no recommendations were generated at all. Short-biased mean-reversion or breakdown strategies would have fit best.

improvements.action: Debug and fix the zone score fallback pipeline — verify it actually scans all 50 Nifty symbols and outputs results when AI is unavailable. Add a minimum output floor of at least 3-5 candidates even if scores are below normal thresholds, flagged as 'low-confidence' rather than producing zero output.
improvements.reason: Zero recommendations on a day with clear directional regime (ADX=25, Nifty -0.6%) means the fallback system is broken or misconfigured, not that there were genuinely no setups across 50 liquid stocks.

improvements.action: Lower the minimum zone score threshold for the fallback mode from its current value to at least 60 (or whatever is 20% below the AI-mode threshold). When AI is offline, accept slightly lower conviction setups rather than sitting out entirely.
improvements.reason: The fallback produced exactly zero setups across all 50 Nifty stocks, which is statistically implausible — the threshold is clearly too tight for the non-AI scoring method.

improvements.action: In trending_down regimes with ADX>=22, force the scanner to prioritize SELL/SHORT setups at supply zones on stocks with relative weakness vs Nifty. Specifically scan for stocks that fell more than Nifty (-0.6%) and are approaching overhead supply zones.
improvements.reason: Today's regime was ideal for short setups but the system had no regime-aware override to ensure at least some directional trades were surfaced.

improvements.action: Add an alerting mechanism: if the morning scan produces zero recommendations, trigger a re-scan with relaxed parameters (e.g., widen zone proximity from 0.3% to 0.8%, reduce min volume filter by 30%) within 15 minutes of market open.
improvements.reason: A full day with zero activity is the worst outcome for a paper trading system — we learn nothing. Even low-conviction trades provide data for calibration.
